title: A previous-generation MCP client installed into a newer runtime: caret peers on 0.1.x cannot be satisfied by 0.2.x

reported.symptom: user could not add an MCP server at all; installing @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client@0.1.0-rc.7 was rejected as incompatible with dsh 0.2.0-rc.1
reported.runtime_trace: the package declares @deepseek-ai/dsh-* peer ranges at ^0.1.0-rc.7, which a 0.2.0 runtime cannot satisfy; the version is already shipped inside dsh itself
user_hypotheses: MCP needs a separate install step (it does not: 0.2.0-rc.1 bundles it)
reported.root_cause: caret peers on 0.1.x vs runtime 0.2.0-rc.1 -> admission denies every @deepseek-ai/dsh-* requirement
reported.fix_verified_by_responder: remove the separately installed package; an MCP server is then just a cordis.patch.yml entry at the built-in version

deviations: the original failure happened at install time; this case models the state after such an install (which upstream now refuses) so the same engine path is exercised
bundles omitted; no full dependency install
